styleBlocks.css: .import-btn-secondary { background: var(--bg-card); color: var(--text-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border); }
.import-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--text-primary); border-color: var(--border); }
.modal h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px; }

.modal-close,
  .context-back-btn { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

styleCoverage: Every ordered original rule mentioning any captured class or ID, plus applicable tag/universal foundations; full selectors/declarations/at-rule ancestry preserved. No class-prefix filter.
captureBoundary: Expected markup is produced exclusively by SHA-verified copied original emitted functions. Controlled runtime ports supply synthetic state/facts; unchanged shared helpers are byte-guarded against the frozen Git baseline. No migrated renderer/projector is invoked.
sourceLabelBoundary: Stateful label reader runs once for manual, three times for nonmanual; factory once per eligible source. Cold and loaded public facades compare byte-exact.
lifecycleBoundary: Actual copied original public preview/conflict-mode/confirm/cancel functions execute with controlled ports. Original Lab marker is deliberately retained on shared host; original focus options are recorded, not repaired.
